title: Shopify Discounts — Display Patterns, Line Items & Cart Level
content: Official Shopify discount display guidelines (from shopify.dev). Discounts apply through three mechanisms: automatic discounts (merchant-configured), manual discount codes (customer-entered at checkout), and Shopify Scripts (deprecated — sunset June 30, 2026, migrate to Shopify Functions). DISCOUNT SCOPE: (1) Line item level — applied to specific products in cart. (2) Cart/order level — applied to entire cart or order total. LINE ITEM DISCOUNTS: Show strikethrough original price plus discounted price when applicable. Display each discount with its amount using line_level_discount_allocations. Key Liquid properties: original_price, original_line_price, final_price, final_line_price, line_level_total_discount. CART-LEVEL DISCOUNTS: Display between subtotal and total. Access through cart_level_discount_applications. Show discount title and total_allocated_amount. CALCULATION ORDER: Subtotal (after line discounts) → Cart discounts → Total. Manual discount codes can only be applied at checkout — they do not appear in cart template. FIGMA IMPLICATION: Design three price states for every product card and line item: (1) Regular price — single price, no decoration. (2) Sale/compare-at price — original price with strikethrough, sale price in accent colour. (3) Discounted price with discount label — show the discount name/badge alongside the adjusted price. For cart design, always include a discount summary row between subtotal and total. Design the cart to handle multiple stacked discounts (line-level + cart-level showing simultaneously).

title: Shopify Shop Pay Installments — Banner Placement & Implementation
content: Official Shopify Shop Pay Installments guidelines (from shopify.dev). Shop Pay Installments allows customers to pay for orders between 50 USD and 3,000 USD in 4 interest-free instalments. BANNER: Informs customers of payment plan options. Includes 'Learn more' link opening pop-up with instalment amounts, feature details, and required disclosures. PLACEMENT LOCATIONS: (1) Product forms — position below product price for visual grouping. Banner auto-updates when variant selection changes. (2) Cart forms — position below cart subtotal. Add data-cart-subtotal attribute to subtotal element for automatic updates. IMPLEMENTATION: Uses {{ form | payment_terms }} Liquid filter within product or cart form tags. Banner appears only if Shop Pay Installments is enabled in merchant's store. FIGMA IMPLICATION: Design the installments banner as a subtle inline element below the price — not a card or callout box. Use Shopify's purple Shop Pay brand colour for the logo mark. Standard format: 'or 4 interest-free payments of $XX.XX with [Shop Pay logo]'. Position: directly below the main price on product pages, directly below subtotal on cart page. Design it at a smaller type size than the main price — it is supplementary information, not primary. Include the 'Learn more' link that opens a modal with full instalment details.
